author: Mirco
name: Causal Convolutional LM (MLX)
blurb: Replaces transformer attention blocks with causal depthwise-separable 1D convolutions of increasing kernel sizes (3, 5, 7, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25, 31). Each block has a depthwise causal conv for spatial mixing + pointwise relu^2 MLP for channel mixing, both writing to the residual stream. Maintains encoder/decoder skip connections and x0 residual mixing from the baseline.
